content.introduction: For the earnings calendar and analysis for the week of October 5-9, the sources indicate that there are no noteworthy earnings reports scheduled for release before the open on Wednesday, October 7. The sources also mention earnings estimates for Constellation Brands ($3.55 per share), Penguin Solutions ($0.77), and Worthington Steel ($0.92). Additionally, the sources provide an analysis of the soft drink and salty snack maker, which reported third-quarter earnings per share (EPS) of $2.34 on revenue of $25.25 billion, beating Wall Street forecasts. The company's management has trimmed its full-year guidance, narrowing its top-line range from 2% to 4% to approximately 3%.
body:
The soft drink and salty snack maker reported third-quarter EPS of $2.34 on revenue of $25.25 billion, beating a Wall Street forecast for $2.30 on $24.98 billion. Growth was driven by international operations, as beverage volumes in North America declined by 2% and food volumes were flat. [...] Management also trimmed its full-year guidance, narrowing its top-line range from 2% to 4% to approximately 3%. Rather than the low end of 5% to 7% EPS growth, the company is now tracking at something like 2.5% to 3.5%.

PEP had shed more than 11% year to date through October 7 vs a gain of 15% for the S&P 500. The share price for what's still one of the best dividend stocks was down 23.8% since reaching a 52-week high on February 12.
